title: Dubious Potions (Ominous Bottle Fix)
description: A fix for ominous bottles in 1.20.5
body:
### Requires 1.21 Experimental Data Pack
This data pack serves as a "fix" for [Mc-270021](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-270021), by replacing the ominous bottles with _Dubious Potions_, that correctly apply the Bad Omen effect in survival. Could be of use for servers who have the experimental pack enabled in earlier versions.

Extraction not required
